svg.aria-label: Textee against TextMate, CotEditor, Sublime Text and TextEdit: speed and memory
svg.text: Speed and memory, measured from outside each app the same way. Lower is better on every row. 13th October 2026, Apple M1 Ultra, macOS 26.5.
OPEN FILES IN THE RUNNING APP
geometric mean of value / best value
Best, or within 5% of the best
Closer to the best → further from it (log scale)
Medians of rounds 2 to 7: round 1 is a warm-up. Every app ran with its owner's settings, no session restore, a 1920 × 1080 window and the same files.
The Mac was busy (load average 13 to 9), so CPU time is steadier than clock time. Launch times include about 1 s of macOS work.
TextEdit doesn't colour Markdown or code; the 4 others do. Sublime Text's figures include its plugin processes.
